- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.67) — reduce forecast peak values by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices after strong downward sentiment (sentiment < 0.33) — add 3–5% to forecast to avoid premature mean reversion.
- Overshoot after recent spikes — cap forecast 3–5 days after peak at 10–15% below peak value.
- Mean reversion bias: if sentiment is neutral or negative over 3+ days, reduce forecast by 2–4% per day until sentiment turns.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in the cycle — adjust downward by 3–7% for days 1–7 of forecast horizon.
- If sentiment is consistently positive but price declines, reduce forecast slope — avoid “sentiment-driven” momentum overestimation.
